mainMenuNewGame.a09Contract: Play Opening Cutscene sequence ONLY when starting New Game (isContinue === false) and player/debug flag has not disabled intro.

mainMenuContinueGame.a09Contract: MUST bypass Opening Cutscene completely when isContinue === true.

skipControl.button: Visible [BỎ QUA / SKIP] pill after 1.0s hold/fade
skipControl.onSkip: Stop video/timeline cleanly, ramp down cutscene audio within 250ms, restore AudioManager focus, transition smoothly into GameScene.startAct0Intro() at Fog Crossing.

mediaErrorFallback.trigger: video element error, timeout (>3s load stall), or unsupported codec in headless/low-spec Chromium
mediaErrorFallback.behavior: Fail-safe immediate fallback to stylized in-engine cold-mist caption card / fadeIn into GameScene.startAct0Intro() with zero black screen or softlock.

subtitleIntegration.rendering: Must remain legible over 16:9 dark letterbox bar at bottom-center without clipping Vietnamese diacritics.

reducedMotionSupport.behavior: Disable pan/zoom camera shakes, use static keyframe crossfades (>=400ms soft dissolve) instead of fast motion or bright flashes.

audioSettingsSync.behavior: Cutscene media/overlay audio MUST multiply by effective AudioManager volume and respect isMuted immediately; never leak playing audio into GameScene after skip or completion.

constraints: PlayerState.memoryAwakeningStage remains 0 on New Game arrival.
HUD remains neutral: '🌲 Lữ Khách Rêu Phong'.
